hooks.command: body=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_RESULT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(r.get('body',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); missing=''; for section in '## Summary' '## Changes' '## Test Plan'; do echo "$body" | grep -qF "$section" || missing="$missing $section"; done; [ -z "$missing" ] || echo "WARNING: PR body is missing required sections:$missing"
